Strukturen är underlag för koncernens in: The structure is the basis for the group's internal reports. It changes nothing in any company's books.
Gör om en tidigare lista till koncern: Turn an earlier list into a group
Dina tidigare listor under Koncernöversi: Your earlier lists under Koncernöversikt are only yours. Choose a list and a parent company, and a group is created that everyone in it can see. The list is kept and nothing in the books changes.
Du ser ingen koncern ännu: You do not see a group yet
En koncern syns här när du är ägare elle: A group appears here when you are an owner or administrator and create it, when you may see reports in all of its companies, or when you have been given the role to read its summary.
Du har rollen att läsa koncernens samman: You have the role to read the group's summary. You see the companies' names, who owns what and the share of the capital held, but no details about individual companies.
Det bestämmande inflytandet anges av en: The controlling influence is entered by a person and is not derived from the votes. A company with a disposed holding is not included in periods after the disposal.
Innehavet skrivs i det ägande företagets: The holding is written in the owning company's own register. If a holding in the same company already exists, it is changed. A company must have a recorded holding before it can be added to the group.
Du måste vara ägare eller administratör: You must be an owner or administrator in the company and in every company already in the group.
Rollen ger bara koncernens sammanställni: The role gives only the group's summary, never access to any individual company. Someone who reads the summary and also sees the parent company's own reports can work out the subsidiaries' totals.
Ta bort rollen för :name: Remove the role for :name
Det här är din egen lista. Den ersätts a: This is your own list. It is replaced by a group that several companies can share, with a parent company, holdings and roles.
NONOX prövar inte om företagen utgör en: NONOX does not assess whether the companies form a group under the Swedish Companies Act or the Annual Accounts Act. The structure is based on the holdings you have recorded yourselves.
Inte dotterföretag genom detta innehav: Not a subsidiary through this holding

Företag och ägande enligt de innehav ni: Companies and ownership according to the holdings you have recorded yourselves, with the status of the fiscal years in each company. NONOX does not assess whether they form a group.
